name: Oishinbo Kyuukyoku no Menu Sanbonshoubu
original_name: 美味しんぼ 究極のメニュー三本勝負
source:
This title translates as “Gourmet,” graphic and text adventure game based on the popular manga comic book series “Oishinbo.”

Who knew a game about food could be interesting? Before you can even say kawahagi(filefish) or fugu (blowfish), you too can become an enthusiast of the culinary arts of Japan. You won’t have to watch Iron Chef to know the difference between foie gras and ankimo (monkfish liver). Follow the exploits of Shiro Yamaoka with the help of intern Yuko Kurita to find the best entrée for the Tozai Publishing 100th Anniversary banquet.

[From [url=http://www.boojumsnark.com/oishinbo.html]boojumsnark.com[/url]]
translation:
本作是一款根据热门漫画《美味大挑战》改编的图像与文字冒险游戏，标题意为“美食家”。

谁能想到，一款关于食物的游戏也会如此有趣？还没等你说出“剥皮鱼”或“河豚”，你也会成为日本料理的爱好者。无需观看《料理铁人》，你也能分辨鹅肝和𩽾𩾌鱼肝的区别。与实习生栗田优子一起，跟随山冈士郎的脚步，为东西新闻社创社百周年纪念宴会寻找最出色的主菜。

[摘自[url=http://www.boojumsnark.com/oishinbo.html]boojumsnark.com[/url]]
